---
name: 'Draft Blog Post'
description: "Draft a blog post in Jay's style from rough notes, portfolio updates, app launches, life updates, or GitHub URLs."
argument-hint: 'Paste your update notes and optional links.'
agent: 'Blog Post Ghostwriter'
---

Write one complete blog post from the user input.

Requirements for the post:

- Use exactly one chapter header at the top.
- Write in paragraphs only.
- Keep the tone informal and straight to the point.
- Use the Oxford comma consistently.
- Do not use em dashes.
- Do not use contrast framing like "not this, but that".
- Do not use bullet lists.
- Do not add section headers after the chapter header.
- If links are provided, extract concrete facts before drafting.

Return only the finished post text.
